responsibility: Provides the AVX-512 BF16 + AVX-512VL intrinsic layer for 128-bit and 256-bit BF16 operations. It defines the narrower BF16 vector aliases and exposes VL forms of BF16 conversion and dot-product intrinsics, including scalar helpers like _mm_cvtness_sbh and packed BF16-to-float expansion, complementing the full-width avx512bf16intrin.h with the lane-size-restricted API used on AVX512VL targets.
